works.body:
I am a VTuber, and my name is Hau Amano.
 I would like to send a request to MAiCO to draw an illustration for my goods.

The main purposes of use are
Activities as Hau Amagumo such as Youtube videos, channel headers, thumbnails, etc. (*Monetized)
 Activities on SNS such as X (including icons and headers)
Returned goods (PC wallpaper)
Stickers and other Valentine's Day merchandising

 ○ Character ○
I would like you to draw me (Amakumo Hau).
I have silverish pale blue-white hair and human ears.  Please do not remove the cat ears.
I have two eye colors: blue-gray and pink. Either color is fine. (Not odd eyes).
Please leave the clothes, hair, and pose to us.
We would be happy if you pick, hold, or eat cake or chocolate!

 ○Hau motif
Cats, ribbons, batons, plasters, clouds, roses
Mine, Lolita, and subculture types
○Specifications, etc.
If you draw a background, we would appreciate it if you could separate the background from the character (if the background is not available, please leave the background blank).
(If the background is not available, please leave the background out.) We would like to receive both PNG and PSD files.

Thank you in advance. . ᐟ

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lccpE453sQH62WEPi-Y8k3wxBgzGv1cZ

初めまして、MAiCOさんのプロセカイラストとコスデザインがいつもめちゃ好きですね　ﾄﾞｷﾄﾞｷ

私のリクエストは「うちのKAITO」とテーマはプロセカです。

・うちのKAITOの瞳はピンくなハートです。
猫っぽいな人ですね。
https://x.com/sarunamirabu/status/1806502341073379349?s=20

・このリクエストはOKであればMAiCOさんの『さくらブレザー』コステームをお願いしたいです。
OKじゃないであれば服装はお任せします。

・私は英語プロセカでKAITOさんランキングな人ですから、
私の好きなイベント称号の「花」をお願いしたいです。称号の花は青いですね（HONEST  7）。
https://x.com/sarunamirabu/status/1961634932779831351/photo/1

・構図とポーズはお任せします。

よろしくお願い致します！！
